d: The dysfunctional owners of the O Face Bar are so inexperienced and chaotic Jon doesn't even know if he wants to save their business.
Ever since extended family members were put on the payroll at The Tailgate in Santa Clarita, CA, business has taken a nosedive.

st: When Life Doesn't Hand You Lemons
d: Faced with a PDA-obsessed manager and an owner solely focused on his own retirement, the staff at Pat's Cocktails calls Jon for help.
Maria Menounos helps Jon scope out a bar whose owner sits around as her husband does all the work and her dad picks up the bill.
Jon heads to Katy, Texas, to save Bryant's Ice House, which is plagued by a bad reputation, an even worse location and a wild staff.
Jon helps Justin and Michael, a pair of strippers who own The End Zone bar in Houston, put aside their differences before they lose more than just their shirts.
Jon's crew gets caught in the middle of a massive brawl at a New York sports bar when the customers discover they're being served cheap booze at premium prices.
The customers call the shots at a rowdy Staten Island bar where they pour their own drinks and cook their own food, so Jon tries to help the owners retake control.
Jon must deflate the ego of a Puerto Rican bar owner who berates his staff and sons as his bar sinks further into debt.

st: Anything You Can Yell, I Can Yell Louder
d: In order to save a failing Queens dive, Jon has to quell the raging tempers of three loudmouthed, firefighting brothers.
Jon shows up to help a former Philadelphia detective turned bar owner who has been hitting the bottle too hard after years on the force.
Jon enlists a failing bar owner's ex-wife and former manager to help get the business back on course.
An outrageous owner spends more time swinging from the rafters than managing his bar, and Jon is ready to abandon the rescue if the owner doesn't face reality.
A third-generation Milwaukee bar owner takes his father's legacy for granted and refuses to take on the inherited mantle of leadership.
An Irish bar owner's American dream threatens to go up in smoke when Jon discovers he's been withholding employees' paychecks to keep the business afloat.

st: Too Many Managers, Not Enough Man
d: Jon is tasked with rescuing a Chicago sports bar that's heavy on managers and light on respect for the owner.
The hippie-dippie owner of a Chicago music venue is more concerned with the spirit of wonderment than appealing to her trendy community, so Jon introduces some tough love.
A failing beachfront bar is shut down after rodents invade the kitchen, and Jon is brought to tears by what the owners have endured.
Jon crashes the party at a failing bar where out-of-control bartenders would rather dance than pour drinks.
When the owner of an outdated college sports bar would rather spend his time playing fantasy football, Jon gives him a dose of reality.
